  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build trust and strong relationships.
  • Fluent in English (additional languages are an advantage).
  • Remote work experience is beneficial but not required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a trusted partner, coach, and enabler for managers and teams within your assigned business units.
  • Collaborate with the People Partner Team to design, implement, and improve initiatives, tools, and strategies that align with Remote’s global People strategy.
  • Manage and resolve employee relations issues with empathy, effectiveness, and alignment to Remote’s values.
  • Own and execute the global offboarding process, ensuring a positive and respectful employee experience.
  • Advocate for Remote employees and serve as a go-to resource across the organization.
  • Partner with colleagues globally to foster an inclusive, effective, and thriving workplace.
  • Provide async and sync guidance on performance management, career development, feedback, and complex conversations.
  • Contribute insights and ideas to strengthen Remote’s high-performance culture.
  • Collaborate with the wider People Team on programs and initiatives across the employee lifecycle.
  • Analyze people data and trends to inform decisions and improve strategies.

  • Be an active ambassador of Remote’s Handbook.

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Director of People Partners

  • Location : EMEA or AMER (EST timezone)

Remote Compensation Philosophy

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore, we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hire globally.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $35,200 USD to $79,200. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

Application process

  • Interview with team members (no managers present)
  • Prior employment verification check

title: Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish It Industry
description:
Overview

Sweden needs skilled engineers! About 30 000 of them by 2030 to be precise, according to the Swedish Statistical Central Bureau. Right now we have ~200 open positions for Software Engineers with our clients in Sweden. As a senior headhunter you will help us to find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden. Living standards in Sweden are great by any international comparisons, and we need a lot of engineers. Your job will be to find them and inform them about all the benefits of living and working in Sweden. To move to another country is often one of the biggest leaps in life, so a lot of your job will be to build trust with suitable candidates.

Supporting you in these tasks, you will have the assistance of a competent global team of recruiters, as well as an executive management team in Sweden. In addition you will be supported by our Swedish delivery management team that handles all practical matters related to the relocation to Sweden for our consultants. In short we fix everything for our employees - visa, work permits, tickets, housing, you name it - we fix it!

Our clients are primarily within the fields of software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development. Your work will be planned and executed together with your colleagues in Albania, Argentina, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Colombia, Hungary, Kenya, North Macedonia, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela and Vietnam. You will be part of an efficient team characterized by a profound joy for having the opportunity to be able to help engineers and their families to build a new career and life in Sweden. Telescope's core values are joy, trust, and professionalism!

Responsibilities

  • Identify and recruit engineers for Sweden-based roles across software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development.
  • Inform candidates about the benefits of living and working in Sweden and build trust to facilitate relocations.
  • Coordinate with global recruiters and Swedish delivery management to handle relocation logistics (visa, work permits, tickets, housing, etc.).
  • Plan and execute recruitment activities with colleagues in multiple countries.
  • Ensure a positive candidate experience and manage expectations throughout the process.

Qualifications

  • Required competence: at least 5 years of professional experience from recruitment in the IT sector, or similar technical experience.
  • A solid and well proven network of local engineering talent within IT.
  • Extremely service oriented, with a flexible mindset towards always finding the best solution for the challenge at hand.
  • High quality and brand awareness.
  • Understanding or interest in headhunting and the principle of IT outstaffing/outsourcing companies.
  • Upper intermediate English.
  • Some knowledge of contemporary IT technologies and methods, and the ability to learn new technologies.
  • Analytical, well organized with attention to detail, with the ability to identify and close a recruitment request.
  • Self confident, happy, social, friendly and outgoing with a high level of self motivation.
  • Durable and persistent, with the capacity to take a \"no\" as a reason to try harder.
  • Passionate about success, with an executive yet relaxed attitude towards work, colleagues and customers.
  • Responsive and responsible, with an appropriate and representative appearance.

Employment details

  • Extent & Duration: Start ASAP.
  • Full time.
  • Long term contract as a Private Entrepreneur. Minimum 12 months.
  • Eight hours of efficient work per day, Monday to Friday.
  • Overtime compensation 1:1 in flex.
  • Location: You will be working from home or from a co-location center of your choice.
  • Economy: Remuneration starting at 1200 USD, plus remittance fees and taxes.
  • Free national holidays, with maintained payment.
  • 20 paid vacation days.
  • Paid travels, housing, and per diem.

title: CDI Validation Specialist
description:
Overview

Position: CDI Validation Specialist

The CDI Validation Specialist assists the CDI Manager with oversight, evaluation, and analysis of CDI functions including efficiency, accuracy, continuing education needs, and overall quality. This individual identifies individual education needs of Clinical Documentation Specialists and collaborates with CDI Manager, IP Coding Manager, and IP Coding Validation Manager to develop appropriate training materials. The primary goal is to ensure the documentation in the chart identifies all clinical findings, diagnoses and procedures and is appropriately and clinically supported. The CDI Validation Specialist will work with the CDI Manager to leverage performance, providing feedback and influence to continually improve documentation results thereby impacting key performance indicators.

Department: Clinical Documentation

Schedule: Full Time

Responsibilities

  • Monitors CDI staff accuracy, data quality and integrity.
  • Monitors CDS review process for content, timeliness and accurate diagnosis and procedure assignment in determining a working DRG.
  • Monitors concurrent queries for compliancy, accuracy, clarity, and timeliness.
  • Audits clinical documentation specialists retrospectively to assess for completeness of chart review and query compliance including missed query opportunities, accurate coding, and adherence to AHIMA/ACDIS compliant query guidelines/standards.
  • Collaborates with CDI manager to identify, coordinate, and implement CDI specialist ongoing education and feedback based on identified opportunities for improvement via auditing.
  • Assists in orientation and training of new clinical documentation specialists
  • Reviews and analyzes denial claims and denial data to provide support in denial prevention strategies via clinical validation query process and education to CDI specialists.
  • Contributes to departmental and organizational quality performance goals, including auditing mortality and readmission cohorts to identify opportunities for improvement. Coordinate and implement CDI specialist education based on identified opportunities.
  • Collaborates with CDI manager to create and update documentation tools, processes, procedures, and work flows on an ongoing and as needed basis.
  • Reviews charts concurrently with no MCC/CCs, low SOI/ROMs and LOS not supported by working DRG.
  • Identifies and educates CDI with missed query opportunities.
  • Assists CDI manager with final DRG validation when there is a discrepancy between CDS and coder.
  • Collaborates with the CDI Manager and identifies opportunities for performance improvement activities on processes.
  • Collaborates with CDI Manager, IP Coding Manager, and IP Coding Validation Manager to strategize appropriate training methodology for individual issues.
  • Provides timely appropriate feedback to CDI Manager on any performance improvement plans for CDI staff.
  • Collaborates with other CDCI department managers to identify areas for improvement and solutions for process improvement.
  • Assures documentation is compliant with federal and state regulations, coding guidelines and hospital policies.
  • Remains up-to-date in clinical and coding/documentation-related materials, including CDS best practices as defined by ACDIS as well as ICD-10-CM/PCS, AHA Coding Clinic guidelines for coding and reporting and MS-DRG/APR-DRG classification systems.
  • Monitors regulatory and reimbursement changes.
  • Serves as resource for CDI informational needs and updates CDI on coding changes, medical science and CDI practice standards.
  • Provides guidance, support and expertise to the CDI specialists
  • Track trends in documentation concerns and implementing solutions for improvement.
  • Uses leadership and critical thinking skills to identify opportunities for team processes and engagement
  • Recommend solutions for improvement when deficiencies are identified.
  • Provides CDI specialists, coders, and coding validation specialists with clinical feedback to assist in accurately capture diagnoses and/or opportunities for querying physicians post discharge for additional information.
  • Evaluates the success of concurrent documentation improvement on an ongoing basis.
  • Advances professional growth and development through participation in educational programs and workshops and maintaining knowledge of industry standards and practices.
  • Assists manager, when requested, in the development of APR/DRG/query response physician reports. Maintains complete confidentiality of patient information in addition to hospital and individual physician practice pattern data.
  • Assumes operational oversight of CDI department in the absence of the CDI manager.
  • Adheres to all BMC’s RESPECT behavioral standards.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Note: The above statements depict the general nature and level of work assigned and are not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties and responsibilities.

Job Requirements

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in nursing, health information management or related field and at least five years (5) years experience in clinical documentation, or equivalent combination of education and experience, required.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Master's degree

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations Required

  • Licensed RN

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations Preferred

  • CCDS, CDIP

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (KSAs)

  • Demonstrate advanced knowledge of clinical documentation integrity practices, policies, workflows, and analysis.
  • Critical thinking, analytical and problem solving skills
  • Highly organized with strong project/task management skills
  • Knowledge of federal, state and payer specific regulations, policies and guidelines pertaining to coding (inpatient or outpatient), documentation requirements and billing
  • Experience with 3M Encoder/Grouper, SMART software preferred
  • Knowledge of care delivery documentation systems and related medical record documents.
  • Knowledge of age-specific needs and the elements of disease processes and related procedures.
  • Strong broad-based clinical knowledge and understanding of pathology/physiology of disease processes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent critical thinking skills.
  • Demonstrated employee and medical staff relationships in the past and has the ability to maintain those going forward.
  • Working knowledge of inpatient admission criteria.
  • Ability to work independently in a time-oriented environment.
  • Computer literacy and familiarity with the operation of basic office equipment.
  • Assertive personality traits to facilitate ongoing physician communication.
  • Ability to be adapt to changes in the workload, to work independently and effectively prioritize work assignments
  • Working knowledge of Medicare reimbursement system and coding structures preferred, but not required.
  • Familiarity with physician practices, health information, case management or related healthcare discipline
  • Familiarity with all government health care reimbursement systems
  • Have experience working collaboratively with diverse groups in a health care environment
  • Demonstrated success in interacting effectively with physicians
  • Excellent speaking, writing and teaching skills
  • Proficient with standard Microsoft programs (i.e. MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and web browsers.
  • Ability to analyze large amounts of data to identify trends.
  • Ability to provide direction and development to employees by coaching, identifying training needs, assigning progressively challenging projects, and assisting in career development planning.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Overview

It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

Job Description Summary:

Job Overview: As a Senior Project Manager at Rocket Software, you will lead the delivery of primarily complex mainframe modernization projects for Rocket’s full product suite, typically ranging from $500k to $2M in services revenue, and occasionally overseeing more complex transitions or transformations valued up to $10M. In this role, you will coordinate multi-function, multi-vendor project teams—often spanning multiple regions—to meet aggressive but achievable deadlines while driving meaningful customer outcomes.

A strong technical background in one or more focus areas—such as infrastructure modernization, application modernization, process modernization, hybrid cloud deployments, microservices architecture, or enterprise-wide DevOps—is key. You’ll leverage this expertise to define project objectives, outline detailed delivery plans, and ensure alignment with customers business goals. Throughout the project lifecycle, you will collaborate with diverse stakeholders, including consultants, software engineers, end users, sales teams, and senior leadership, while maintaining transparency, accountability, and clear communication.

As part of the Rocket team, you will embrace and exemplify our core values of Empathy, Humanity, Trust, and Love, ensuring a customer-centric approach in every interaction. You’ll partner with colleagues to continually refine best practices and methodologies, promoting a culture of innovation and continuous improvement. Ultimately, you will play a pivotal role in delivering high-value solutions and exceptional experiences that help customers modernize their technology landscapes and achieve strategic success.

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery Excellence & Customer Experience

  • Oversee the entire project lifecycle for large, high-risk, and often multi-region initiatives—managing timelines, deliverables, and quality standards to meet aggressive yet achievable deadlines.
  • Define and document clear project scope and objectives, preventing scope creep by continuously aligning all stakeholders with the project’s goals and deliverables.
  • Utilize Rocket’s project management framework to optimize workflows, accelerate time to value, and ensure customer-centric outcomes.
  • Coordinate requirement-gathering sessions, project kickoff meetings, status updates, and review meetings, maintaining transparency and alignment between internal teams and external clients.
  • Act as the primary interface with customers, forging trust-based relationships grounded in Rocket’s core values of Empathy, Humanity, Trust, and Love.
  • Monitor project risks and proactively address any challenges, conflicts, or schedule deviations to maintain project momentum and a positive customer experience.

Revenue Optimization & Portfolio Management

  • Collaborate with internal and customer stakeholders to match project resources, schedules, and financial parameters with contractual requirements.
  • Maintain transparent communication to set clear expectations around timelines, scope, and any potential risks affecting delivery or cost.
  • Provide reliable financial forecasts to management, adjusting as necessary based on evolving project scopes and timelines.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales to proactively identify and pursue additional revenue opportunities, particularly for complex, high-risk engagements, by leveraging on-the-ground insights during project delivery to align emerging customer needs with Rocket’s broader solutions portfolio.
  • Lead or support early qualification and opportunity assessment for significant modernization projects, ensuring alignment with Rocket’s strategic objectives.
  • Maintain a well-rounded portfolio of customer engagements, balancing priorities and resource allocations to maximize both revenue potential and customer satisfaction.

Operational Excellence & Process Transformation

  • Implement and continuously improve standardized policies, procedures, and best practices that support consistent, high-quality project delivery.
  • Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and analyze project data to identify trends, address inefficiencies, and enhance operational effectiveness.
  • Use data-driven insights to inform decision-making, refine delivery approaches, and recommend process optimizations that reduce complexity, cost, and time-to-market.
  • Establish clear governance structures and reporting processes, providing stakeholders with real-time visibility into project progress, financial health, and risk status.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that reinforce Rocket’s commitment to innovation, operational excellence, and delivering transformative customer outcomes.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Mentor and coach project managers to enhance their leadership and delivery capabilities.
  • Guide project managers in handling customer escalations with a problem-solving mindset, ensuring resolutions align with Rocket’s values and maintain strong customer trust.
  • Develop and implement career development plans for team members.
  • Drive a culture of continuous learning, fostering knowledge sharing across teams.
  • Implement coaching frameworks to support exceptional customer experiences and project outcomes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Account Executives during project delivery to keep them informed on progress, collaborate on customer challenges, and seek their support in resolving key issues.
  • Collaborate with Product Development to align project execution with the product roadmap.
  • Work closely with Customer Success Management, Product Engineering, and Delivery Engineering to ensure seamless customer engagements.
  • Facilitate communication between technical and business stakeholders, driving alignment on project goals and priorities.

Requirements

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Project management certification preferred (e.g., PMP, PgMP).
  • Additional certifications in Agile methodologies are beneficial.

Experience

  • 12+ years of progressive project management experience, preferably with enterprise-scale portfolios in a professional services organization of a software company (or equivalent related experience).
  • 6+ years leading senior-level customer-facing project managers in a strategic or operational leadership role.
  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth and business transformation through project delivery in a software, SaaS, or enterprise software environment.
  • Experience in cross-functional collaboration within SaaS companies, enterprise software organizations, or consulting environments, working across teams to align project goals and ensure successful delivery.

Skills & Competencies

Leadership and Collaboration

  • Executive-level communication skills.
  • Advanced coaching and mentoring abilities.
  • Transformational leadership with a focus on operational excellence.
  • Expertise in cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management.

Project Delivery and Strategy

  • Resource optimization and portfolio management.
  • Advanced project planning and risk management.
  • Process improvement and change management expertise.
  • Focus on accelerating time-to-value through efficient delivery.

Financial and Operational Acumen

  • Strong understanding of revenue recognition principles.
  • Experience in financial management, budgeting, and performance monitoring.
  • Ability to analyze and address complex operational challenges.

Collaboration Network

  • CSE Delivery Management
  • Sales and Pre-Sales teams
  • Support & Product Development
  • Customer Success
  • Customer stakeholders

Communication Requirements

  • Maintain regular communication with the CSE PMO management team, cross-functional teams, and Functional Leadership.
  • Provide ad-hoc updates on critical project milestones and revenue recognition status.

Information Security

Information security is everyone’s responsibility. A fundamental principle of information security at Rocket Software is that all individuals in the organization have a responsibility for the security and protection of company information and IT Resources over which they have control, according to their role.

Diversity, Inclusion & Equity

At Rocket we are committed to an inclusive workplace environment, where every Rocketeer can thrive by bringing their full selves to work. Being a Rocketeer means you are part of our movement to continually drive inclusivity, diversity and equity in our workforce.

description:
About the job (A) Senior Sales Development Representative

About the role

As a Senior Sales Development Representative at Growth Era, you will be a key player in driving our clients success by managing and optimizing outreach efforts. You'll take on advanced prospecting responsibilities, nurture relationships with key decision-makers, and help guide prospects through the funnel. As a senior member of the SDR team, you'll also mentor junior SDRs and collaborate with sales leadership to refine strategies. Your experience in outbound sales, along with a deep understanding of sales processes, will ensure you play a pivotal role in delivering qualified opportunities for our clients.

Key responsibilities:

  • Generate leads by engaging prospective buyers via cold call, cold email and LinkedIn to schedule qualified meetings.
  • Identify the needs of prospective buyers.
  • Build long-term trusting relationships with prospective buyers to qualify leads as sales opportunities.
  • Schedule meetings between prospects and our clients.
  • Be accountable for weekly, monthly and quarterly results.
  • Maintain accurate and timely notes of all lead interactions within the CRM application.
  • Participate in weekly coaching and development meetings.

Nice to have:

  • Have 2+ years in a high velocity sales environment as a top performing SDR/BDR.
  • Have high proficiency in English within a business environment.
  • Have been successful working for a U.S. based Tech company selling into U.S. prospects, with a strong focus on cold calling.
  • Experience with CRM and SEP software.
  • Proficient with MS Outlook/G Suite.

Key Metrics:

  • Meeting volume: six to 12 new sales qualified attended meetings per month.
  • Ability to work with two clients in different industries.

Your characteristics:

  • Unimpeachable integrity.
  • Resilience and positivity.
  • An overwhelming, energetic and enthusiastic desire to serve clients and win in the marketplace.
  • An ability to collaborate with a diverse group of enterprise clients, prospective buyers and teammates.
  • A commitment to continuous learning and self-development.
  • An ability to thrive in an entrepreneurial environment with demonstrated resourcefulness and self-direction.
  • An unrelenting commitment to excellence.

What we offer:

  • $1,500-$1600 monthly base salary with a strong performance-driven bonus plan, targeting total annual earnings of $34K.
  • Fully remote and full-time contract.
  • Remote work with flexibility to accommodate your lifestyle.
  • Working hours with an overlap with company hours (8 AM - 4 PM EST, Monday to Friday).
  • A friendly working environment, open to free communication.
  • Opportunity for professional growth, training and career development.
  • Regular team-building events in Europe and social activities to foster a positive and engaging workplace culture.
  • Access to the latest sales technologies and tools to help you succeed in your role.
  • Opportunity to be a part of a fast-growing US-based company with an innovative, high-energy culture that is constantly growing.

Also, at Growth Era, you'll be part of a company thats redefining sales development and driving growth for a diverse range of clients. As a Senior SDR, you'll lead strategic outreach, build relationships with decision-makers, and mentor junior team members all while deepening your sales expertise. Join us to make a real impact, grow your career, and help us shape the future of sales development.

Company Overview:

Growth Era is a leading Sales Development as a Service and growth solutions company with a passion for generating high-quality sales meetings for a wide range of organizations. Growth Era's unique business model provides a full-scale, multi-channel outreach Sales Development Department to its clients, all for a fraction of the cost of building and managing this function in-house. Specializing in Sales Pipeline Management and Hubspot CRM Services, Growth Era provides targeted strategies to increase win rates, accelerate sales cycles, and deliver faster revenue growth, making it a trusted partner in the success of your business.

Leveraging specialized talent, economies of scale and continuous analytics over a large volume of outreach, Growth Era feeds its clients Sales pipeline with unmatched results.
